voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Mato Grosso, Brazil, nineteen twenty-five. Percy Fawcett, his son Jack and Raleigh Rimell went into the forest, looking for a lost city he called Z.
He had left word. If they did not return, no one should come looking.
On May twenty-ninth, he wrote to his wife from Dead Horse Camp. You need have no fear of any failure.
It was the last word from any of them. None of the three was ever found.
Searchers went in anyway. Later, bones were said to be his. Scientists in London found they were not.
